text: Salient features: fever with chills, headache, sweating. Suspect malaria in endemic areas with fever lasting more than 48 hours.
Diagnostic tests: peripheral blood smear and malaria rapid diagnostic test (RDT). A negative smear or RDT does not rule out malaria in early illness but repeat testing may be needed.
Salient features: high fever, retro-orbital pain, rash, and thrombocytopenia. Avoid unnecessary antibiotics in uncomplicated dengue.
Diagnostic tests: NS1 antigen, dengue IgM/IgG, and platelet count monitoring.
